IRCAM LISTEN HRTF data notice
=============================

The WebKit WebAudio HRTF resource identified below contains the composite HRTF
dataset derived from measurements in the IRCAM LISTEN database. IRCAM's
published LISTEN terms state that the database is public and available for any
use, and request acknowledgement of the database. IRCAM retains the stated
copyright. This is a separate data permission and attribution; it is not an
SPDX license and does not change the license of WebKit or NeAntik code.

Copyright (c) 2002 IRCAM (Institut de Recherche et Coordination
Acoustique/Musique). All Rights Reserved.

Acknowledgement: IRCAM LISTEN HRTF Database.

Bound runtime resource:
  WebCore.framework/Versions/A/Resources/audio/Composite.wav
  SHA-256: a25fc99a6e875f659aaa9d107c791aeff250030e0d7f16458baf3a00943394e3

Bound corresponding source:
  Source/WebCore/platform/audio/resources/Composite.wav
  SHA-256: a25fc99a6e875f659aaa9d107c791aeff250030e0d7f16458baf3a00943394e3

References:
  IRCAM LISTEN database: http://recherche.ircam.fr/equipes/salles/listen/
  Archived IRCAM measurement record: https://web.archive.org/web/20230408181607/http://recherche.ircam.fr/equipes/salles/listen/info_display.php?subject=IRC_1002
  Reproduced IRCAM terms: https://doc.sccode.org/Other/ATKLicensing.html
  WebKit HRTF consolidation history: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=69703
